note: Report skeletons. Placeholders in double braces are filled from the review record; the checklist supplies the numbered points.

templates.description_en: The workhorse: summary, strengths, numbered major and minor points.
templates.description_ar: القالب الأساس: تلخيص ونقاط قوة وملاحظات جوهرية وطفيفة مرقّمة.

templates.description_en: The science holds; presentation and detail need work.
templates.description_ar: العلم سليم، وتحتاج الصياغة والتفاصيل إلى ضبط.

templates.description_en: Short, warm, and specific about what makes it good.
templates.description_ar: قصير وودود ومحدَّد فيما يجعله جيّدًا.

templates.description_en: Respectful, concrete, and useful to the authors even in rejection.
templates.description_ar: محترم ومحدَّد ونافع للمؤلفين حتى مع الرفض.

templates.description_en: The idea is good; the evidence needs rebuilding.
templates.description_ar: الفكرة جيّدة، والأدلة تحتاج إعادة بناء.

templates.name_ar: الجولة الثانية — ردّ على نسخة منقّحة
templates.description_ar: إقرار نقطة بنقطة على ردّ المؤلفين.

templates.description_en: Structured around leakage, baselines, ablations and reproducibility.
templates.description_ar: مبني على التسريب وخطوط الأساس والاستئصال وقابلية إعادة الإنتاج.
templates.body:
Manuscript: {{manuscript_title}} ({{manuscript_id}})

SUMMARY

{{summary}}

The reported results are strong. Before they can be accepted as evidence of the claimed advance, the manuscript needs to close off the ordinary alternative explanations for a high score. I have organised my comments accordingly.

1. DATA AND POSSIBLE LEAKAGE

{{major_points}}

2. BASELINES AND FAIRNESS OF COMPARISON

[Was each baseline given the same tuning budget as the proposed model? Are the baselines the ones a specialist would name, at their published settings or better?]

3. STATISTICAL SUPPORT

[Are results averaged over several seeds or folds, with dispersion? Is the gap between the proposed model and the best baseline larger than the run-to-run variation?]

4. ABLATION

[Does an ablation isolate the component the paper credits for the gain?]

5. REPRODUCIBILITY

[Architecture, optimiser, learning rate, batch size, epochs, stopping rule, hardware, code availability.]

MINOR POINTS

{{minor_points}}

{{reviewer_name}}
{{date}}

templates.description_en: Coverage, taxonomy, currency, and value beyond existing surveys.
templates.description_ar: الشمول والتصنيف والحداثة والقيمة المضافة على المسوح القائمة.

templates.description_en: Context for the editor that does not belong in the authors' report.
templates.description_ar: سياق للمحرّر لا يليق بتقرير المؤلفين.
templates.body:
Dear {{editor}},

Re: {{manuscript_title}} ({{manuscript_id}})

My recommendation is {{recommendation}}.

Confidence in this assessment: [high / moderate / limited — and for which parts]

My expertise covers: [the parts of the manuscript you are qualified to judge]
Outside my expertise: [the parts you are not — say so plainly, and suggest what kind of second reviewer would cover them]

Additional context for your decision:

[Anything relevant that should not go to the authors: how far the work is from the journal's usual standard, whether the flaws look remediable within one revision cycle, whether the authors seem to have the data to fix them.]

I am willing / not willing to review a revised version.

With regards,
{{reviewer_name}}
{{date}}

templates.description_en: Raises a concern for the editor to verify. Never an accusation.
templates.description_ar: يرفع شبهة ليتحقّق منها المحرّر، لا اتهامًا البتّة.
templates.body:
Dear {{editor}},

Re: {{manuscript_title}} ({{manuscript_id}})

I am writing separately from my review report because something in this submission gave me pause, and I think it is for the editorial office rather than for me to establish whether there is anything in it.

What I observed:

[Describe only what you can point at — a passage whose register differs sharply from the rest, a figure panel that appears to repeat another, a reported result that does not follow from the stated method, a reference list that does not match the citations. Give page and line numbers.]

I want to be clear that I am not making an allegation. There may well be an innocent explanation, and I have no way of checking from where I sit. I am flagging it so that the office can run whatever checks it normally would.

I would be grateful if this note were kept separate from my comments to the authors.

With regards,
{{reviewer_name}}
{{date}}

templates.description_en: Short, states the conflict, offers alternates.
templates.body:
Dear {{editor}},

Thank you for the invitation to review "{{manuscript_title}}" ({{manuscript_id}}) for {{journal}}.

I must decline, as I have a conflict of interest: [state it plainly — a recent co-authorship, a shared institution, a current collaboration or funding relationship, or a competing manuscript of my own on the same question].

I would not be able to give the manuscript an assessment the authors could rely on as independent.

If it helps, the following colleagues work in this area and I am not aware of any similar conflict on their part: [names].

With regards,
{{reviewer_name}}
{{date}}

templates.description_en: Declines the deadline, not the journal.
templates.description_ar: اعتذار عن الموعد لا عن المجلة.
templates.body:
Dear {{editor}},

Thank you for thinking of me for "{{manuscript_title}}" ({{manuscript_id}}).

I am sorry that I cannot take it on within your timeframe — I have [n] reviews in hand at present and I would rather decline than return something rushed or late.

If the manuscript is still with you after [date], or if a similar submission comes up then, I would be glad to be asked again.

Suggested alternative reviewers: [names].

With regards,
{{reviewer_name}}
{{date}}

templates.description_en: Says precisely which part you could and could not judge.
templates.description_ar: يبيّن بدقّة ما تستطيع الحكم فيه وما لا تستطيع.
templates.body:
Dear {{editor}},

Thank you for the invitation to review "{{manuscript_title}}" ({{manuscript_id}}).

Having read the abstract, I do not think I am the right reviewer for it. I could give you a competent view of [the part you can judge], but the substance of the paper rests on [the part you cannot], and there I would be guessing.

Rather than return a review that looks authoritative on a question I am not qualified to settle, I would prefer to decline.

Colleagues who would be better placed: [names].

With regards,
{{reviewer_name}}
{{date}}

سعادة {{editor}} المحترم،

بشأن: {{manuscript_title}} ({{manuscript_id}})

توصيتي: {{recommendation}}

درجة ثقتي في هذا التقييم: [عالية / متوسطة / محدودة — وفي أي أجزاء]

يشمل تخصّصي: [الأجزاء التي أنت مؤهّل للحكم فيها]
وخارج تخصّصي: [الأجزاء التي لست مؤهّلًا لها — صرّح بذلك، واقترح نوع المحكّم الثاني الذي يغطّيها]

سياق إضافي لقراركم:

[كل ما يتّصل بالقرار ولا يليق إرساله إلى المؤلفين: مدى بُعد العمل عن مستوى المجلة المعتاد، وهل تبدو العيوب قابلة للإصلاح في جولة تنقيح واحدة، وهل لدى الباحثين البيانات اللازمة لإصلاحها.]

وأنا مستعدّ / غير مستعدّ لتحكيم النسخة المنقّحة.

وتفضّلوا بقبول فائق الاحترام،
{{reviewer_name}}
{{date}}

سعادة {{editor}} المحترم،

أشكر لكم دعوتي لتحكيم البحث الموسوم «{{manuscript_title}}» ({{manuscript_id}}) في {{journal}}.

ويؤسفني الاعتذار لوجود تضارب في المصالح: [اذكره صراحةً — تأليف مشترك حديث، أو انتماء إلى الجهة نفسها، أو تعاون أو تمويل قائم، أو مخطوطة منافسة لي في المسألة ذاتها].

ولن يكون في وسعي أن أُصدر تقييمًا يَعُدّه الباحثون مستقلًّا.

وإن كان في ذلك عون، فهؤلاء الزملاء يعملون في هذا المجال ولا أعلم لهم تضاربًا مماثلًا: [الأسماء].

وتفضّلوا بقبول فائق الاحترام،
{{reviewer_name}}
{{date}}
